lines.2: 「I don't know if it will be to your taste...」
lines.7: I took a bite under Yoshimi's intense gaze.
lines.9: My chopsticks traveled between my mouth and the lunch box several times.
lines.10: The seasoning was stronger than I'd expected. A little heavy on the salt.
lines.14: 「Is it a little too salty? Ellie's food is lightly seasoned for a girl's palate, so I thought that might be too mild for you.」
lines.15: 「It's perfect. Thanks for putting so much thought into it.」
lines.18: She really didn't have to worry that much.
lines.19: ...Arrows of jealousy tipped with poison were flying at me from all around.
lines.20: Plenty had lodged in me, but I would not wilt.
lines.22: All you guys ever do is watch, right?
lines.23: I worked up the courage to talk to them, and that was why I was sitting here now.
lines.24: 「Tsushima, did you watch Angelus last night?」
lines.25: 「Sure did. I even bought the theme-song CD.」
lines.27: 「Yeah. It's pretty good, so you should watch it too, Ellie.」
lines.29: 「What do you do at home at night, Princess?」
lines.30: 「I will leave that to your imagination.」
lines.32: 「What use would any of that be?」
lines.33: The Princess said it without a trace of concern.
lines.34: 「I think it could be useful in all sorts of ways.」
lines.35: 「I have no need for it. I am not interested in classical music anyway.」
lines.37: 「My apologies for ruining your image of a proper young lady.」
lines.38: 「Hmm, let me see. If you want something suitably high-class, I travel all over the world during long weekends and school holidays.」
lines.40: 「China and Switzerland. I like Italy too. Personally, I cannot bring myself to like France.」
lines.41: 「Don't your parents worry? About you getting kidnapped by someone while you're traveling, for example.」
lines.42: 「Perhaps they believe that if you love your child, you should send them out into the world. As I keep telling you, they are very hands-off.」
lines.43: 「If some villain ever managed to kidnap me, that would simply prove I was no better than that.」
lines.45: 「I am grateful to them. It means I can do as I please.」
lines.46: 「But if you really were kidnapped, I'm sure your parents would panic, whatever they claim now.」
lines.47: 「How insulting. Abducting me would be practically impossible in the first place.」
lines.48: 「Princess or not, you're still a girl.」
lines.50: The Princess planted her elbow on the table.
lines.53: Arm wrestling meant we would have to hold hands.
lines.56: The thought of holding such a beautiful hand had my heart pounding.
lines.57: 「Oh, honestly. Stop dawdling and give me your hand.」
lines.58: She took a firm grip on it.
lines.61: Fine... I would win and show her how manly I was.
lines.62: I put my strength into my arm.
lines.63: But the Princess's hand did not budge an inch.
lines.64: 「See? I am quite strong. Someone like you, Tsushima, is not even a contest.」
lines.66: I almost never lost to anyone who was not seriously trained.
lines.69: She smashed the back of my hand against the table.
lines.71: 「I win. Women are strong these days too.」
lines.75: 「If you call yourself a man, Tsushima, then become a wolf.」
